rivalFates.name: Core Scientific
rivalFates.fate: Renewal wall arrives at the 2028Q2 reset: CoreWeave shell renewals reprice -20%; EBITDA turns positive by 2029 as Denton stabilises.

rivalFates.name: IREN (Iris Energy)
rivalFates.fate: Microsoft prepay smooths the reset; keeps buying MW.

rivalFates.name: CoreWeave
rivalFates.fate: Absorbs the reset; growth slows to ~70% of pre-reset pace.
Carrack Compute launched its own price war and owned the marginal gigawatt by 2040.
Northgate matched Carrack's price in 2038 and rode the launch boom to record value.
Lantern Arc quadrupled its constellation in the launch boom.
Cratermark Resources raised again on cheaper lunar delivery.
Ironvale Power built one reactor of twenty and found the new load had gone to orbit.
